description.value: Bale and Bucket is a restaurant inside Thunderbird Show Park, one of North America's premier equestrian event facilities located in Langley, BC. The park hosts approximately ten weeks of internationally recognized hunter and jumper tournaments each year, drawing world-class athletes and large spectator crowds. A touring cyclist arriving during an event week will find this food option amid a lively atmosphere of show jumping, boutique vendors, and food stands.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The discovered URL (tbird.ca) belongs to Thunderbird Show Park, an equestrian event facility in Langley, BC — not to the Bale and Bucket itself. The FAQ page confirms 'Bale & Bucket' as one of the dining options for park visitors ('meals can be purchased at the Bale & Bucket or at any of the numerous food stands in the Park'), establishing it as a real, publicly accessible restaurant within the venue. No cycling-specific amenities are described anywhere on the site for this restaurant, and the OSM record carries no contact details of its own.
concerns: The restaurant is located inside Thunderbird Show Park and likely only operates during the park's approximately ten-week annual event season; access outside event days is unconfirmed.
Entry to the park during events may require a spectator ticket, which could limit casual access for passing cyclists.
Name discrepancy: OSM uses 'Bale and Bucket' while the website spells it 'Bale & Bucket'.
The discovered URL (tbird.ca) is for the parent venue (Thunderbird Show Park), not a dedicated website for the restaurant. URL discovery confidence was flagged as medium.
